slots.scrim: fixed inset-0 z-modal flex items-center justify-center bg-scrim backdrop-blur-scrim
slots.panel: arena-pop w-120 max-w-[92vw] bg-surface-floating border-[length:var(--bw-surface)] border-edge-surface-floating rounded-surface shadow-surface-deep overflow-hidden
slots.head: px-6 pt-5.5
slots.eyebrow: font-face-eyebrow text-eyebrow tracking-eyebrow case-eyebrow text-ink-eyebrow mb-2 font-eyebrow
slots.title: font-face-heading font-heading text-title-section text-ink-heading tracking-heading leading-heading
slots.body: px-6 py-4 font-body text-md leading-prose text-ink-body/(--level-ink-body)
slots.foot: flex flex-wrap justify-end gap-2.5 px-6 pb-5.5

true.panel: flex flex-col w-full h-full max-w-none rounded-none shadow-none pr-[var(--pad-safe-right)] pl-[var(--pad-safe-left)]
true.head: sticky top-0 bg-surface-floating pt-[calc(var(--sp-1)*5.5+var(--pad-safe-top))]
